text: April 2026: we gave a metal roof in Carrara a soft wash, which is a low-pressure wash, including the carport and patio. The dark stains on the roof sheets and flashing beside the balcony railing were gone, and the roof looked clean again.
alt: Before and after of the roof edge flashing above balcony railing. Before: Flashing and roof sheets with dark stains beside a balcony railing in Carrara
